This page answers one question: **can we actually see the thing people are arguing about?**

If we cannot see it, we say so. We do not fill the hole with a story.

[This week's brief](articles/weekly-brief-2026-w35.qmd) · [Claim register](articles/book-one-coupling-register.qmd) · [Current gates](https://github.com/William-Edgar-Brissey/project-register/blob/main/gods_eye/CURRENT_GATES.md)

## Right now

**Rain.** Nine-place CHIRPS sample. Newest public month: **July 2026**. August is late, not drought.

**Heat.** Same nine places, ERA5. Not a world average.

**Earthquakes.** 1991–2020 M4.5+ background, tropics vs extra. Not your house.

**Fire.** ~5,000 NOAA-20 hotspots on 30 Aug 2026. One box blind.

**Pacific ONI.** May–July 2026 **+1.39**.

## Currents — 28 August 2026 surface sample

These are **one grid cell of satellite-derived geostrophic surface flow** from NOAA AOML (product through 28 Aug 2026). Units: metres per second. **Not** volume transport. **Not** AMOC. A slow cell is not a collapsed conveyor.

| Place | Speed (m/s) |
|---|---:|
| Somali | 1.01 |
| Drake Passage | 0.55 |
| Kuroshio | 0.53 |
| Indonesian Throughflow proxy (Lombok) | 0.52 |
| Florida Straits | 0.33 |
| Equatorial Pacific | 0.20 |
| Gulf Stream (mid-box) | 0.17 |
| ACC south of Africa | 0.11 |
| Brazil Current | 0.11 |
| Agulhas (this cell) | 0.07 |

The Agulhas number is a **point that may have missed the core**. Do not read it as “the Agulhas died.”

**Still not live here**

- RAPID AMOC at 26°N: last full public series **February 2024** — STALE.
- Florida Straits **cable transport (Sv):** interrupted since November 2023 (NOAA note on the 2026 file).
- OSCAR v2 NRT and Copernicus 3D currents: exist behind other portals; not in this job yet.
- OSNAP, MOVE, SAMBA, INSTANT-class ITF volume: delayed arrays.

Raw JSON: [CURRENTS_NRT_2026-08-28.json](https://github.com/William-Edgar-Brissey/project-register/blob/main/gods_eye/CURRENTS_NRT_2026-08-28.json).

Parked: volcanic winter, food-web collapse, “move south.”

## How to use this

Your national warning service first. Empty or late = missing, not calm. Advice, not an order.
